description: Sets (or deletes) env variable values for the service a project deploys. Values are stored encrypted and never shown back to any agent. Other values are kept. On a live project the services whose env changed are redeployed (so confirm first); otherwise they apply on the next deployment. Read values from the person's local .env only with their OK; never invent secrets. Multi-line values are credential files (guide topic env). Needs a key with Operate access.

project.description: The project's id, name or repository (owner/name).

service.description: Service id or name, when the project has several

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.

name: set_env
title: Set env variables
